$comment: PIES task-kind routing registry. Runtime truth for kind routing; docs/wiki/planning/kind-profile-matrix.md is the design rationale. Routing input is pre-run intent + change_spec only.

routing.unavailable_policy: record routing_result unavailable; proceed with base normalization and lead-selected kind
routing.mixed_policy: split into independently valuable nodes when possible; otherwise apply the stricter applicable profile and record the decision

bug.inclusion_signals: A reported or observed behavior violates an existing expectation
bug.required_grounding: Symptom, expected behavior, causal area, prior regressions, affected surface
bug.required_plan_artifact: Minimal reproducer or diagnostic witness; causal hypothesis; regression target
bug.proof_contract: Witness demonstrates the defect before the fix when feasible; same path demonstrates expected behavior after; regression test or durable automated witness prevents recurrence
bug.failure_rule: No credible reproducer or witness means Unproved, never fixed

feature.inclusion_signals: A new user, consumer, or system capability is requested
feature.required_grounding: Actor, journey, constraints, trust boundaries, target surface
feature.required_plan_artifact: Walking skeleton; criterion-to-proof map; types/signatures sketch at function boundaries
feature.proof_contract: Actor completes the journey on the correct real surface, or a real consumer integration proves an internal/library capability; direct evidence per criterion
feature.failure_rule: Unit tests alone do not prove a user-facing capability

refactor.inclusion_signals: Structural or maintainability improvement with no intended observable behavior change
refactor.required_grounding: Observable invariants, consumers, compatibility boundaries, behavior-preserving suite
refactor.required_plan_artifact: Invariant map and change boundary; characterization tests cited by name, added before structural change when needed
refactor.proof_contract: Named existing and characterization tests pass; checks pass; unchanged interfaces and behaviors have direct preservation evidence
refactor.failure_rule: Any intentional behavior, contract, data-format, timing, or performance change routes to another kind

test.inclusion_signals: The requested outcome is new or improved automated verification, not product behavior itself
test.required_grounding: Requested proof mode (behavioral or coverage); existing coverage; fixture realism; relevant wrong behavior
test.required_plan_artifact: Behavioral: test-oracle statement with condition, expected result, relevant incorrect behavior. Coverage: baseline, named scope, target threshold, report command
test.proof_contract: Behavioral: test fails against a relevant deliberately introduced defect, prior behavior, or mutation (temporary targeted mutation is the accepted fallback) and passes intended behavior; stable. Coverage: baseline and final reports meet the explicit criterion for the named scope and the suite passes
test.failure_rule: Coverage alone must not be presented as regression protection; implementation-detail assertions need explicit rationale; an exposed product defect routes as bug

documentation.inclusion_signals: Human-facing or maintainer-facing information with no product behavior change
documentation.required_grounding: Audience, local terminology, scope, affected information
documentation.required_plan_artifact: None special; Scout hands the worker relevant sources and conventions
documentation.proof_contract: No separate proof contract or real-surface requirement; lead evaluates accuracy, scope, clarity, and conventions before merge
documentation.failure_rule: Any product-behavior change routes as a separate bug/feature node

research.inclusion_signals: Read-only investigation producing an evidence-backed answer; no code change requested
research.required_grounding: Authoritative sources, affected files, prior decisions, existing knowledge sink contents
research.required_plan_artifact: Question list with expected evidence form per question
research.proof_contract: Findings report answering the stated intent with cited files/sources per claim; explicit uncertainty and gaps; recommended next actions
research.failure_rule: An unanswered core question without a recorded gap is Unproved; agent idleness is not success
research.procedure: scout -> lead evaluates report; worker optional and read-only; no worktree, commit, merge, or publication gate

codebase-analysis.inclusion_signals: Read-only architectural or maintainability analysis of the codebase
codebase-analysis.required_grounding: Architecture docs, knowledge sink, module boundaries, dependency structure
codebase-analysis.required_plan_artifact: Scope statement naming analyzed areas and excluded areas
codebase-analysis.proof_contract: Scoped findings with file references; prioritized simplification/refactor recommendations; risks and dependencies; proposed independently executable follow-up tasks
codebase-analysis.failure_rule: Findings without file references or without prioritized recommendations are Unproved
codebase-analysis.procedure: scout -> lead evaluates report; worker optional and read-only; no worktree, commit, merge, or publication gate
